name: Project Atlas
summary: Break the original Django monolith behind Pulse into Go and FastAPI services running on Kubernetes.
tech: Go; Python (FastAPI); Kafka; PostgreSQL; Kubernetes (EKS); Terraform

name: Project Compass
summary: Replace spreadsheets and email approvals with ZenPeople, a single HRMS for attendance, leave, payroll and expenses.
tech: ZenPeople HRMS (vendor product); Okta single sign-on; Tally Prime integration

name: Project Beacon
summary: Build the company data platform: an Iceberg lakehouse with Airflow and dbt pipelines feeding analytics and machine learning.
tech: Apache Iceberg; Trino; Airflow; dbt; S3; Metabase

name: Project Sentinel
summary: Achieve ISO/IEC 27001 certification and a SOC 2 report, required by larger enterprise and US customers.

name: Project Lighthouse
summary: Rebuild Pulse Mobile as Pulse Mobile 3.0 in Flutter, with a redesigned inbox and the Zenith Design System.
tech: Flutter; Dart; Firebase Crashlytics; Figma; Playwright (web parity tests)

name: Project Horizon
summary: Expand the Visakhapatnam Care Centre from 20 to 45 seats, with a new training programme and a partner-BPO overflow arrangement.
tech: Genesys Cloud; Zenvora Pulse; Jira Service Management

name: Project Ember
summary: Cloud cost optimisation (FinOps): rightsizing, savings plans, storage tiering and per-team cost allocation.
tech: AWS Cost Explorer; Terraform; Datadog; Kubernetes (EKS)

name: Project Sage
summary: Zenvora Sage, a retrieval-augmented AI assistant that drafts and resolves Tier-1 support replies inside Pulse, with human review for sensitive categories.
tech: Python (FastAPI); PyTorch; Vector search (pgvector); Open-weight and hosted LLMs; Airflow

name: Project Nova
summary: Pulse Insights: churn-risk scoring and an analytics dashboard that tells SME owners which customers need attention.
